profile.description: Energy secretary with responsibility for AI infrastructure and the Genesis Mission.

summary.text: Wright describes AI as an opportunity to empower people, improve productivity, and benefit society broadly. He advocates expanding electricity production to support AI growth while limiting increases in ratepayer costs. He presents U.S. leadership in AI as a national-security necessity, specifically citing competition with China.
